name: Dhol Beat
summary: A mehndi night rhythm game: marigolds fall onto three drums and you hit each one on the beat
about: A full-screen courtyard on a mehndi night, with cusped arches, swaying string lights, marigold garlands, a dhol player and a dancing crowd that bounces on every beat. Flowers drop down three lanes onto a bass drum, a clap and a treble drum; hit them as they land to build combos and keep the crowd's energy up across five songs that get faster. The beat, the drums and the tune are made live in the browser, so there are no sound files.
how: A demo set plays on load; press Take the drum, Play, any lane key or tap a drum to start.
Hit F or the left arrow for Boom, Space or the down arrow for Clap, and J or the right arrow for Tick, or tap the drums.
Time each hit to the moment a flower lands: Perfect, Great and Good score more with a combo multiplier up to four times.
Hold the key or the drum through long garlands; misses drain the crowd energy and an empty meter ends the game.
Clear a song to move to the next, faster one; P or Escape pauses, R restarts and the speaker button mutes.
Your best score is saved on this device, and reduced motion stops the shaking, sway and confetti.
